projects.title: Hoya Botto — An Automation Cooperative for Kesennuma
projects.description: Hoya Botto explores affordable AI-assisted robotics for Kesennuma manufacturers, starting with one box flap. A proposed automation cooperative shares engineering, trains local people and measures savings.

projects.title: KesenMemento
projects.description: KesenMemento turns Kesennuma into a digital playground, so that users can play in both in virtual worlds and reality. As users play more, the digital twin of KesenMemento improves!

projects.title: 魚籍
projects.description:
気仙沼の魚が水揚げされてから消費者に届くまでのサプライチェーンをブロックチェーンで管理し、IUU漁業による違法漁獲ではないことを証明するシステム。
気仙沼で獲れた魚1匹1匹の戸籍となる。

projects.title: デジカレ受講生専用ページ / Digital College UP Student Page
projects.description:
気仙沼の女性向けデジタル学習プログラム「デジタルカレッジUP」の受講生専用ページです。LINEで流れてしまいがちな次回のお知らせや申し込みフォームを一か所にまとめ、チャットボット「デジカレくん」が質問に答えます。答えられない質問は事務局に届きます。

A one-stop page for students of Digital College UP, a digital skills program for women in Kesennuma: next-session info, application forms, and a chatbot that forwards unanswered questions to staff.

projects.title: SharkShield
projects.description: SharkShield is a device for long line tuna fishers that detects hooked fish, records fishing events, and activates an electric deterrent intended to reduce predation by sharks.

projects.title: GALAXSI — Super Intelligent Factory
projects.description:
A proposed advanced manufacturing and training hub in Kesennuma, Japan. It brings together shared production equipment, AI, robotics and practical learning to help local businesses develop products, solve industrial problems and build new skills.

Kesennuma already has deep experience in fisheries, food production, machinery and repair. GALAXSI builds on that knowledge, making modern manufacturing capabilities more accessible without requiring every business to build its own specialist team or facility.

The goal is practical: strengthen local industry, create opportunities for the next generation and develop skills that are relevant anywhere in the world.

Learn here. Build here. Compete anywhere.

projects.title: Citizen Sentiment
projects.description: Citizen Sentiment is a simple app that enables Kesennuma city officials to gather the preferences of citizens about a future project. It’s primarily visual where images, in A/B format, are distributed in multiple media, including web, app, and paper. Each distribution includes a QR code link. Citizens can scan the QR code and land on a page in the Citizen Sentiment app. They make a choice between image A and B and submit their preference. The city can then gauge the sentiment of the populace when making design decisions.
